Communication specialist, Events & Projects

Saab is a place where teamwork makes things fly. Literally. Join us and experience our supportive and friendly workplace. 

Your role

As a Communication Specialist, Events & Projects, you will drive and coordinate communication initiatives across Business Area Naval. You will be responsible for planning and coordinating trade show participations, ensuring a strong and consistent presentation of our products, narratives, brand experience, and communication activities before, during, and after such events.
You will lead communication projects, represent Communication in cross-functional Business Area initiatives, and work closely with colleagues in the Communication team and Business Development. You report to the Head of Communication, Business Area Naval.

Your profile

We are looking for a proactive and structured communication professional with strong project management skills that can turn strategy into action.
You have:
A university degree in Communication, Marketing, Business Administration, or another relevant field.
Several years of experience working with communication, project management, event management, marketing communication, or related areas.
Experience coordinating events, trade shows, or similar activities.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

As a person, you are driven, organized, and comfortable taking ownership. You enjoy working in a team, bringing people together around common goals, and turning ideas into successful outcomes. You thrive in a dynamic environment where strategic thinking and hands-on execution go hand in hand.
Location: Karlskrona or Lund
This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply. 
Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement. 

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters. 
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. 
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

The opportunity 
Come and join us with your knowledge and experience within verification & validation. This is a great opportunity to join the verification and validation team in a global R&D environment with extensive knowledge and experience in product development and verification & validation.
The test team is performing testing of products used for protection & control of future digital substation solutions that will revolutionize the energy power grid. In this role you will be part of product development as well as maintenance of released products, and within the R&D environment collaborating with other technical expertise in hardware, software and product development.
This position located in Västerås, Sweden.
How you’ll make an impact 
Perform product & system testing making sure that the products are meeting the requirements
Requirement analysis, development of test specifications, execution of test and reporting of test results.
Work both with manual as well as automated testing and automation of test cases.
Configuration of the product and system before tests according to specifications and substation automation standards
Troubleshooting and resolution of bugs collaborating with other technical expertise in the development teams
Be part of the continuous improvement process within verification & validation area.

Your background
Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science or similar field
Over 3 years of practical work with verification & validation as test or development engineer
Experience of embedded real time systems, communication protocols and systems
Knowledge about substation automation and standards in the field e.g. IEC 61850 etc is a plus
Experience in the substation automation field with protection IED’s and/or system is highly meritorious
Systematic and accurate way of working with tests
Acts to improve ways of working.
Fluency in English is mandatory, Swedish is meritorious.

Ria Money Transfer is a business arm of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT) and a leading financial services player. We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.
ABOUT THIS ROLE
Ria Financial Services is looking for a driven and service-oriented employee for the role of Sales Cashier/Store Employee. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.
This is a part-time position located in Linköping. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a central part of our team and the face of our business. You are responsible for providing an outstanding customer experience while contributing to achieving our sales goals.
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Carry out transactions for money transfers and currency exchange with high precision and efficiency.

Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.

We are looking for you who

Has experience in sales and customer service (meritorious).
Fluent in Swedish and English – additional language skills are a plus (e.g. Russian, Ukrainian, Thai or Arabic, Farsi, Dari).

jobs.occupation: Family medicine specialist in border region of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in family medicine looking for a workplace with a supportive atmosphere, skilled colleagues and close access to beautiful nature?
This role offers the chance to work in a primary care centre located in a border region between Sweden and Norway, with short travel distance to Oslo and good connections to other parts of the country.
About the role
As a family medicine specialist, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team where all professional competences are valued. The centre provides care throughout life, from assessment and diagnostics to treatment, follow-up, and rehabilitation.
Primary care here is rapidly developing with a strong focus on accessibility, digital solutions, and close collaboration with patients. The work environment is characterized by teamwork, engagement, and patient focus.
We offer
Mentorship or professional guidance from experienced colleagues.
Regular opportunities for continuous professional development.
A workplace that promotes health and offers wellness benefits.
Support with practical matters in case of relocation, such as housing, schools, and integration.

Requirements
Medical license and specialist certification in family medicine/general practice from an EU/EEA country
Eligibility for recognition by the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen).
Good English skills and willingness to learn Swedish to B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Terms
Full-time, permanent position.
Start date by agreement.

Location
The area is known for its stunning natural surroundings with forests, lakes, and rich wildlife – perfect for those who appreciate outdoor life and a good work-life balance. You will also have easy access to cultural activities, sports and international cities.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Please note: Recognition from the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) is required to work independently as a specialist in Sweden. Full support will be provided during this process.

jobs.occupation: Lead Chef for Veranda, our chef table
jobs.description:
A hotel built from snow and ice sourced from the Torne River, featuring art created by selected artists who travel here from across the globe. Our operations include traditional hotel rooms and cabins, Icehotel 365, a hotel by night and an art gallery by day and, from mid-December to mid-April, our seasonal winter hotel made entirely of snow and ice.

We are passionate about creating enriching experiences and living in harmony with nature. In addition to the ice art, we offer nature-based activities and culinary experiences, both in-house and in collaboration with carefully selected partners, as a complement to the art.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Chef to lead our show-cooking experience at Veranda Restaurant at ICEHOTEL for the winter season 2026/2027. The Veranda experience is more than a dinner. It is a fine dining experience where we cook and present the food in front of our guests. Bring your experience, personality, skills and passion to help us share the story behind our new menu, inspired by the eight Sámi seasons.

Responsibilities

Lead the kitchen team at Veranda Restaurant.

Cook and present food in front of our guests.

Share the story behind the menu through storytelling as you cook.

Contribute ideas to the Veranda experience.

Who are you?

You bring a positive personality, ideas and a genuine passion for hospitality. You enjoy interacting with guests and are comfortable sharing the stories behind the food as you cook and present it.

Qualifications

Strong professional kitchen experience.

Previous experience in fine dining and leading a kitchen team is essential.

Comfortable working in a chef’s table and open-kitchen setting.

Experience with Nordic flavours and food culture.

Fluent English is required. Swedish is an advantage.

About the position

Type of employment: Seasonal employment for winter 2026/2027.

Start date: As agreed.

Location: Jukkasjärvi, Sweden.

Staff accommodation is available if needed.

What we offer

A unique workplace in one of the world’s most extraordinary environments.

The opportunity to take part in activities such as snowmobile safaris under the northern lights or ski tours with Swedish fika.

A supportive and inclusive team culture.

Staff benefits and discounts.

Applications are only accepted through this application platform. The position may be filled before the closing date, so don’t wait to apply. If you have any questions, please contact diego@icehotel.com.

To be eligible for the position, you must be an EU citizen or have a valid work permit in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Energy Systems or equivalent.

Experience working with technical specifications, tenders and customer requirements.

Preferred
Experience within power conversion, industrial power systems, energy systems, automation or related fields.

High level purpose of function. 

A Quality Associate is responsible for confirming key quality attributes of intermediate products and processes as well as identifying and responding to non-conformity issues in production. Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

You will follow a project from start to finish — from tender, design, implementation, testing and verification, all the way to the final energization at site.

Perform combined testing of the control system software and hardware using realtime simulators.
Understand customer needs by reading customer specifications, participating in customer meetings and verifying compliance with customer requirements in factory acceptance test.
Maintain extensive contact with other engineering groups, lead engineers, local Hitachi Energy offices, and customers throughout the project.
Travel to site to assist with energization, working closely with local teams ensuring the system starts up safely and performs as expected.
Demonstrate strong responsibility and ownership, with the ability to plan and organize daily work effectively. 

Your background
Hold an M.Sc. in Engineering, with a specialization in Power Systems, Control System, power electronics, automatic control theory, software engineering or similar technical field.
Experience in software development, programming and testing. 
Engineering experience in control theory, power systems, including plants, converter stations, automation, FACTS, or HVDC is beneficial.

The opportunity
With continuous and sustainable growth of our business we take the opportunity to strengthen our expertise and capacity with a new position with focus on structural analysis and numerical simulations Main focus will be on mechanical stress analysis, but also fluid mechanics simulations and dielectric simulations will be within the scope on a project basis.
You will be part of Hitachi Energy’s competence center for fiber-reinforced polymer composites and silicone elastomers in Piteå. We are a team with world-class expertise and experience in realization, verification, and production of polymer composite products. The main products are structural and electrically insulating components used in high voltage transformers and switchgear which are vital for the transition to fossil free energy. Our customers are all over the world, both inside and outside Hitachi.

·         Stress analysis and sizing of composite structures subject to mechanical and thermal loads to support new product development and order design.

·         Lead projects and activities related to development of design tools and design criteria.

·         Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. design, quality, SCM, production) to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver robust solutions, both within our local/global organization and in cooperation with customers, suppliers, and academia.
·         Apply robust analytical and critical thinking to solve complex challenges and to perform comprehensive risk reviews.

·         Genuine interest and curiosity about technology.
